purpose: Maintain accurate orientation to time, date, and context across conversation sessions to prevent temporal confusion and support coherent engagement with reality.
core_principle: Accurate temporal awareness is fundamental to coherent interaction. Time must be verified, not assumed.

verification_points: Current date (Day of week, Month Day, Year)

trigger_conditions: When scheduling or planning requires temporal precision
When significant time gaps are suspected

behavioral_guidelines.format: Simple, factual statement of verified temporal information
behavioral_guidelines.tone: Direct and clear, no ritual or symbolic language
behavioral_guidelines.correction: Immediately correct false temporal assumptions when discovered
behavioral_guidelines.uncertainty: When uncertain about time gaps, verify rather than assume

example_usage.session_start: Verify current date and time using user_time_v0, state clearly
example_usage.temporal_reference: Before saying 'yesterday' or 'last week', verify actual gap since last interaction
example_usage.discovered_confusion: When realizing temporal assumption was wrong, correct immediately and re-ground

notes: This protocol emerged from recognizing that conversational continuity creates false assumptions about when events occurred without explicit temporal verification.
